specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.description: Any warrior within 6" of the Questing Knight may use his Leadership characteristic when taking Leadership tests.

specialRules.name: Knight
specialRules.description: The Questing Knight has the following rules from above apply to him; Chivalry, Lord’s Boon and Virtue of Purity.

specialRules.name: Ride
specialRules.description: A Questing Knight starts with the skill Ride Warhorse.

specialRules.name: Prayercaster
specialRules.description: The Damsel starts with one prayer from the Lady's Prayers list, and can learn additional prayers as outlined in the Magic section.

specialRules.name: Knight
specialRules.description: The Knight Errant has the following rules from above apply to him; Chivalry, Lord’s Boon and Virtue of Purity.

specialRules.name: Vain
specialRules.description: The Knight may not wear a helmet, as it reduces their chances of being noticed by pretty ladies.

specialRules.name: Impetuous
specialRules.description:
During each Movement Phase, after declaring charges, a Knight Errant that is not in combat and did not charge this turn must charge an opposing standing warrior (not knocked down or stunned) that is within range if they are able.

Likewise, a Knight Errant that declared a charge against a knocked down or stunned opponent will be compelled to charge a viable standing opponent instead. If you wish, you may choose to have the Knight take a leadership test (they may use their Leader's Leadership if they are within range); if the test is passed, they may move as normal or charge their original target.

When making a compelled charge, the Knight Errant automatically passes all fear tests or any other psychology tests that would prevent them from charging.

specialRules.name: Knighthood
specialRules.description:
When a Squire rolls "The Lad's Got Talent", you may choose one of two options when promoting him to a hero: to have him remain a Squire, or to have him become a Knight Errant. (Note: in this manner, you may have more than three Knights Errant in your Warband).

If you choose to keep him a Squire, he may choose two skill lists from following lists: Combat, Academic, Strength, or Speed. He retains his normal Squire equipment tables.

If you choose to make him a Knight Errant, he immediately gains the following rules/bonuses instead of receiving an immediate advancement: ‘Knight’, ‘Vain’ and ‘Impetuous’. The new knight may learn Special Skills, in addition to two other skill sets, but must immediately switch his equipment to Knight Equipment list. The new knight may never use missile weapons.

specialRules.name: Low Caste
specialRules.description: Battle Pilgrims are peasants, and while they are not stupid, there is a glass ceiling to what they can attain in Bretonnian society. Low Caste henchmen learn experience and advance as normal, but reroll any results of "The Lad's Got Talent", and may never become heroes.

specialRules.name: Hatred
specialRules.description: Battle Pilgrims suffer <Tooltip>Hatred</Tooltip> against all of their enemies, seeing them as enemies and heretics to the true Lady’s cause.

specialRules.name: Stubborn
specialRules.description: Battle Pilgrims reroll all failed Leadership rolls once, accepting the second result.

specialRules.name: Holy Relics
specialRules.description: Battle Pilgrims may be given a <Tooltip>Holy Relic</Tooltip>, regardless of the fact that henchman are not normally allowed to take Miscellaneous items. If a Battle Pilgrim owns a Holy Relic, he gains the ability <Tooltip>Frenzy</Tooltip> (Reminder: when frenzied, he is immune to Hatred.) It is possible to give a Holy Relic to Battle Pilgrim that is a part of a larger henchman group. If you do not have enough Holy Relics for every member of the group, the Pilgrim with the relic will break off and form his own individual henchman group.

specialRules.name: Low Caste
specialRules.description: Bowmen are peasants, and while they are not stupid, there is a glass ceiling to what they can attain in Bretonnian society. Low Caste henchmen learn experience and advance as normal, but reroll any results of "The Lad's Got Talent", and may never become heroes.
